name: MonarchDiffViewer
title: DiffViewer
summary: Shows what changed between two texts or two versions of a document, unified or side by side: added and removed lines, changed words inside them, folded unchanged runs, totals and previous and next change buttons.
whenToUse: To compare two versions of a text the person reads: a document's version history, an edited configuration, a proposed change to a template.
whenNotToUse: To show one version of code, use MonarchCodeBlock (its diff option marks + and − lines of a patch the app already has). To compare structured records field by field, use a merge dialog or a description list.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDiffViewer(before: List<String>, after: List<String>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, mode: MonarchDiffViewerMode? = null, onModeChange: ((MonarchDiffViewerMode) -> Unit)? = null, granularity: MonarchDiffViewerGranularity = MonarchDiffViewerGranularity.Word, context: Int? = 3, beforeLabel: String? = null, afterLabel: String? = null, showModeSwitch: Boolean = true, showLineNumbers: Boolean = true, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), labels: MonarchDiffViewerLabels = MonarchDiffViewerLabels(), actions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchDiffViewer(before: String, after: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, mode: MonarchDiffViewerMode? = null, onModeChange: ((MonarchDiffViewerMode) -> Unit)? = null, granularity: MonarchDiffViewerGranularity = MonarchDiffViewerGranularity.Word, context: Int? = 3, beforeLabel: String? = null, afterLabel: String? = null, showModeSwitch: Boolean = true, showLineNumbers: Boolean = true, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), labels: MonarchDiffViewerLabels = MonarchDiffViewerLabels(), actions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchDiffViewerLine(kind: MonarchDiffViewerLineKind, text: String, oldNumber: Int? = null, newNumber: Int? = null)
enum class MonarchDiffViewerLineKind { Same, Added, Removed }

class MonarchDiffViewerLabels(caption: ((before: String, after: String) -> String)? = null, before: String? = null, after: String? = null, mode: String? = null, unified: String? = null, split: String? = null, stats: ((added: Int, removed: Int) -> String)? = null, added: String? = null, removed: String? = null, blankLine: String? = null, expand: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, previous: String? = null, next: String? = null, position: ((index: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, noChanges: String? = null)

options.name: before
options.description: The earlier text: its lines or blocks (one entry per paragraph for a document), or a string split on line breaks.

options.name: after
options.description: The later text, in the same shape.

options.name: mode
options.description: The layout when the app owns it. null is side by side from 768dp of width and unified below; the reader's choice in the switch is then kept by the viewer (rememberSaveable).

options.name: onModeChange
options.description: Called when the reader picks a layout in the switch.

options.name: granularity
options.description: Word also marks the changed words inside a changed line; Line marks whole lines only.

options.name: context
options.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change; longer runs fold behind a Show N unchanged lines button. null never folds; a negative value counts as 0.

options.name: beforeLabel
options.description: The name of the earlier side, such as a version name; read in the TalkBack name of the lines and for side by side rows.

options.name: afterLabel
options.description: The name of the later side.

options.name: showModeSwitch
options.description: Whether the segmented layout switch is shown. It is only shown when two columns fit (768dp).

options.name: showLineNumbers
options.description: Whether line numbers are shown: both numbers in unified, one per side in side by side. Hide them for document blocks.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the lines, for example to restore the position.

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls at the end of the header, such as Restore.

states.name: unified
states.description: One column: the removed lines, then the added lines of each change, each with both line numbers and a + or − marker.

states.name: side by side
states.description: Two columns: the k-th removed line beside the k-th added line; an empty side has the subtle background fill.

states.name: folded
states.description: Unchanged runs longer than the context fold into a full-width ghost button that shows them.

states.name: current change
states.description: After previous or next, the first row of that change has an accent bar at its start edge and is scrolled into view (at once when animations are off).

states.name: no changes
states.description: "No changes." in the muted text color instead of the lines.

appearance: A surface in the surface background role with a subtle border and the medium radius. Added lines use the subtle success fill and removed lines the subtle danger fill; changed words have the success or danger border color as a fill, removed words are struck through and added words underlined. Markers and totals use the strong success and danger colors, line numbers the subtle text color, the current change bar the solid accent. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The diff algorithm is ported from the web (longest common subsequence over lines, then over words, with the same limits), not shared. The web is a table that scrolls sideways; on Android long lines wrap so the text grows with the font scale, and the layout switch appears only from 768dp because two columns do not fit a phone. The viewer is a LazyColumn, so it needs a bounded height and cannot sit inside a verticalScroll; iOS lays it out in the app's ScrollView instead. Previous and next scroll the list and announce "Change 2 of 5" through a polite live region; Compose has no API to move TalkBack focus to the change, so focus stays on the button (the web and iOS move focus). The web's controlled mode, defaultMode and onModeChange are mode and onModeChange here; the default follows the width instead of being unified. The web's hidden column headers (Line before, Line after, Change, Text) have no TalkBack counterpart because each row is read as one element; their strings are not offered. iOS uses the same names; showsModeSwitch and showsLineNumbers are showModeSwitch and showLineNumbers, following Compose naming.
accessibility: The lines are a traversal group named "Changes from <before> to <after>".
Each unified line is one TalkBack element read as its text after "Added" or "Removed"; an empty line reads "Blank line". Line numbers and markers are not read.
A side by side row reads each side after its name, or once when the line is unchanged.
The totals read "2 added, 2 removed" instead of the + and − figures.
Previous and next announce "Change 2 of 5" through a polite live region.
Changes are marked by + and − signs, strikethrough and underline as well as color.
Text wraps and grows with the font scale; the buttons have 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: Inputs with more than a million line pairs show every line removed and added; lines with more than 250,000 word pairs are not split into words.
A change of the texts resets the expanded runs and the current change; new lists with the same lines keep them.
A run of unchanged lines only one longer than the context is shown instead of folded.
An empty before shows every line as added.
Previous and next appear only when there are at least two changes.

examples.title: Unified
examples.template:
MonarchDiffViewer(
    before = listOf({{before.0}}, {{before.1}}, {{before.2}}, {{before.3}}, {{before.4}}),
    after = listOf({{after.0}}, {{after.1}}, {{after.2}}, {{after.3}}, {{after.4}}, {{after.5}}),
    modifier = Modifier.height(560.dp),
    beforeLabel = {{beforeLabel}},
    afterLabel = {{afterLabel}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchDiffViewer(
    before = listOf("# Refund policy", "Refunds are available within 14 days.", "Contact support to start a refund.", "Refunds go back to the original payment method.", "Processing takes up to 10 days."),
    after = listOf("# Refund policy", "Refunds are available within 30 days.", "Contact support or use the billing page to start a refund.", "Refunds go back to the original payment method.", "Processing takes up to 5 business days.", "Partial refunds are possible for annual plans."),
    modifier = Modifier.height(560.dp),
    beforeLabel = "Version 3",
    afterLabel = "Version 4",
)

examples.title: Document blocks side by side, chosen by the app
examples.code:
MonarchDiffViewer(
    before = listOf("Welcome to Acme.", "Our office is in Leeds."),
    after = listOf("Welcome to Acme.", "Our office is in York.", "We are hiring."),
    modifier = Modifier.height(320.dp),
    mode = mode,
    onModeChange = { mode = it },
    showLineNumbers = false,
)
